properties.name: An idea connected to nothing can be offered its likely neighbours — and the offer never draws the edge
properties.statement:
A design SHALL be able to answer, for an idea that connects to nothing, WHICH OTHER NODES IT MIGHT BELONG WITH — and SHALL never draw the relation on the strength of that answer.

DISTINCT FROM `dec:idea-linking-half-ideas-needs-a-task-that-can-be-run`, which the guard surfaced and which is its parent: that node ASKS whether the gap needs a runnable task and holds three shapes with none chosen. This is the INTENT that came out of it once the answer was built — what must hold of any such mechanism, whichever shape it took. The question stays open about shape; this is not open.

WHY IT IS INTENT: detecting the absence is not closing it. `unreviewed_ideas` counts the ideas carrying neither a relation nor a note; `review_relations` records either ending; the brainstorm skill instructs linking at capture. All three legs existed and 110 of 183 open ideas still reached nothing, because the capture-time rule — "judge the near-matches you already have, do not run a fresh sweep" — is correct when a duplicate-guard search is in hand and gives a session working the BACKLOG nothing at all.

MEASURED COST, twice in one day (2026-08-25): a session reasoned about functional allocation without reaching an idea recorded seventeen days earlier that had ANTICIPATES-ed its exact error, and discussed the storage model without reaching the node that answered it. Both were recovered by the user's memory. A person must not have to be the index.

EVERY CANDIDATE SHALL CARRY THE WALK THAT PRODUCED IT. A candidate whose reason cannot be stated is not offered, because a suggestion a reader cannot check is a false neighbour waiting to be drawn.

AN ASSERTED CONNECTION OUTRANKS AN INFERRED ONE. A shared neighbour is something a person wrote into the graph; shared vocabulary is incidental and two authors can reach for one metaphor. The ordering SHALL be categorical rather than a tuned weight, because a weight chosen to make one example come out right is taste presented as arithmetic.

AN EMPTY ANSWER SHALL SAY WHICH EMPTY IT IS. "Nothing to compare against", "this node carries no comparable text" and "ranked N and none matched" are three different facts, and only the last means the idea may be genuinely new.

IT SHALL NOT DEPEND ON A SEARCH INDEX. `search_design` is gated behind `fulltext` and fails loud without it, so a suggester built on it would be absent from every index-less build and untestable by the gate that holds most of the tests.
